package_registration.evidence: Play Console package-registration record; do not store account details in this repository.

versioning.release_rule: Every Play upload uses an unused increasing positive versionCode at or below 2100000000; versionName is the user-visible SemVer-compatible release train version.

artifacts.purpose: Candidate AAB for the dedicated Android TV Play track; it becomes uploadable only after a protected upload-key signing lane and Play App Signing setup.
Controlled device-lab or recovery artifact only; not the normal Play upload

signing.play_app_signing: Google manages the distribution app-signing key after Play App Signing is configured.
signing.upload_key: A separate upload keystore signs the AAB before upload; its file, alias, and passwords remain protected CI secrets or vault references.
signing.repository_rule: No signing file, alias value, password, certificate, or Play service-account credential is committed.
signing.compromise_action: Revoke or reset the upload key through Play Console, rotate protected CI references, and record the incident in release evidence.

play_distribution.track_strategy: Use the dedicated Android TV release track after Android TV form-factor opt-in; do not duplicate TV artifacts on the mobile release track after that choice.
play_distribution.internal_gate: Signed AAB, current Data Safety and App Content declarations, reviewer access, TV screenshots/banner, all automated gates, Android TV AVD evidence, and required device-lab evidence.
play_distribution.beta_gate: Internal gate plus NVIDIA SHIELD and current Google TV physical-device evidence, release notes, SBOM, provenance, and approved rollout owner.
play_distribution.stable_gate: Beta observations accepted, Sony BRAVIA coverage, full quality checklist evidence, Play review approval, staged rollout/rollback approval, and durable release evidence.

store_assets.alt_text: Amber play symbol in a dark navy rounded media tile.

store_assets.requirement: Capture at least one unaltered current Android TV screen from an AVD or physical TV after the approved test server/device-link flow is available; do not substitute mockups or private media.

candidate_data_categories: app-scoped random device identifier used for device linking and remembered-profile preference
profile-scoped playback activity sent to the selected self-hosted server
manual privacy-redacted support bundle content only when a user exports and shares it
play_app_content.declaration_rule: A privacy or policy owner must confirm actual transmitted data, purposes, sharing, encryption, retention, ads, target audience, and account-deletion obligations for every distributed artifact. Never predeclare that the app collects no data.

runbook_requirements: Use a non-production Duskcue server with legal test media only.
Provide a time-bounded reviewer account or device-link path through Play Console App Access without committing credentials.
Describe remote-only server selection, device linking, profile selection, playback, captions/audio, Watch Next setting, and manual support-bundle export.
State that Duskcue bundles no catalog and accesses only the selected user-controlled server.

automated: Android TV unit tests, lint, and debug assembly
Shared contract, client fixture, playback, auth, TV/deep-link, accessibility, diagnostics, client-CI, and release-readiness verifiers
Android TV AVD installation, Leanback launcher, and valid custom deep-link smoke
manual_release_required: Unaltered Android TV screenshots and Play store asset review
Google TV launcher/Watch Next visibility and direct deep-link launch
Remote focus, TalkBack, captions/audio, overscan, reduced motion, and Back-to-launcher walkthrough
NVIDIA SHIELD and Sony BRAVIA playback, HDR/audio/subtitle, standby/resume, and diagnostic export evidence

supply_chain.sbom: cyclonedx-android-tv.json placeholder; generate from the protected release build and retain with the release evidence manifest.
supply_chain.provenance: GitHub artifact attestation placeholder; create only from the protected release workflow after signing boundaries are approved.
supply_chain.retention: Debug CI artifacts are short-lived. Release bundle digest, SBOM, provenance, and approval/runbook evidence follow RELEASE_ARTIFACT_RETENTION.md.

rollback.rule: Do not reuse or lower versionCode. Halt a staged rollout when possible, retain the prior Play artifact reference, and publish a higher-versionCode hotfix or use the approved Play rollback path.
rollback.local_state: A rollback must preserve or explicitly migrate encrypted session/profile/Watch Next/artwork state before a release claim.
